info.title: Dahua Access Control API — Frontend Integration
info.description: Curated frontend-facing REST API subset for backend version 1.1.3. Legacy person/card APIs, standalone network-interface APIs and maintenance-only routes are omitted. The device WebSocket at /ws/devices is documented separately in NEXTJS_FRONTEND_API_HANDOFF.md.

post.description:
Reactivate a previously assigned card without creating a new card record.

A new UserCardAssignment history row is created; the old inactive link is
retained with its original ended_at timestamp. The controller card itself
is updated in place and must be inventory-verified afterwards.

DeviceCardRecordDeleteRequest.title: DeviceCardRecordDeleteRequest
DeviceCardRecordDeleteRequest.description: Explicit confirmation for deleting one physical Dahua card record.

local_ip.title: Local Ip
local_ip.description: Optional IPv4 address of the PC network adapter connected to the controller LAN.

DevicePersonProfileRead.title: DevicePersonProfileRead
DevicePersonProfileRead.description:
Safe personnel fields returned by Dahua's access-user service.

Credential secrets and raw biometric payloads are deliberately omitted.

ManualReprovisionVerificationRequest.title: ManualReprovisionVerificationRequest
ManualReprovisionVerificationRequest.description: Manual confirmation for devices whose firmware cannot read card inventory.

StationCardAdoptRequest.title: StationCardAdoptRequest
StationCardAdoptRequest.description:
Link an existing person-based card to a station role without re-enrolling it.

The legacy AccessCard row remains intact for compatibility and history. The
new station assignment is the cloud-owned record used for USER/STAFF
reporting and post-reset reprovisioning.
